sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

Following welfare checks on businesses between Starbucks and McDonald's Queen Street, observed a Police prisoner-transport vehicle outside 205 Queen Street. Police were arresting an individual identified as Ricky, for reasons unknown to security. Remained on standby to maintain a visible security presence. (Photo on file.)
Departed the area and continued patrols towards Britomart.

Arrived at Jo & Joe and received an update from staff regarding a guest who may require removal from the premises later in the day; security assistance may be requested if the situation escalates. Remained on standby while maintaining security presence.
Departed Jo & Joe and continued welfare checks on surrounding businesses.
Welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store, Coffee Club, White Lady and Wilson Carpark; all locations clear with no issues reported. Continued patrols towards Gore Street.
Completed patrols along Gore Street, including welfare checks at Auckland Harbour Suites and Sol; all clear with no concerns reported. Maintained a visible security presence in the area.
Departed Gore Street and continued patrols towards Britomart.

Checked in with Majet at 77 Convenience Store on Customs Street and conducted a welfare check at Coffee Club; both businesses clear. Assisted a visitor from Christchurch who was looking for a nearby coffee shop by escorting him to Coffee Club.

Observed a market operating behind Britomart Train Station towards Britomart Mall; the event appeared calm and orderly with no disturbances observed. Continued welfare checks on surrounding businesses.
Welfare check at Kowhai Cafe and patrols around TK Square completed; both locations clear with no issues reported.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart; all clear with no concerns reported. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed Britomart and continued patrols towards Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart; all clear, no issues reported.

Observed a community event at St Patrick's Square hosted by Lifewise for homeless individuals, including food, music and performances; no disturbances observed. Continued patrols towards the intersection of Victoria Street and Federal Street.

Arrived at the Victoria Street and Federal Street intersection; welfare checks at V-Phix Mobiles, 77 Convenience Store, News Agency, Coffee Club and Eighty Fed. Observed increased pedestrian activity involving homeless individuals heading towards the Lifewise event at St Patrick's Square. Continued patrols towards Elliott Street.
Completed patrols along Elliott Street and Darby Street; both areas clear with no issues reported.

Received complaints from Lumi Cafe regarding homeless individuals gathering around the corner of the premises, with an unpleasant and overwhelming odour reported in the area. Security assessed the surroundings before continuing welfare checks on businesses along Queen Street.
During patrols, observed a male vagrant playing loud music in a public area; continued monitoring before proceeding towards Lorne Street and High Street.
Welfare check at Radisson RED Hotel; remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed the area and continued patrols towards High Street.
Completed patrols along Lorne Street; all clear, no issues reported. Continued towards Metropolis.
Welfare check at Metropolis; all clear with no concerns reported. Remained on standby while maintaining security presence.
Completed welfare checks throughout Chancery Square, Freyberg Place and High Street; all businesses clear with no issues reported. Continued patrols towards Fort Street.
Spoke with Will from Prestige, who provided an update regarding New World security personnel pursuing an individual; security received the information and continued monitoring the surrounding area.

Welfare checks at Evans Kebab, Vape Haven, Haven Mart, The Right Track and Jo & Joe; all businesses clear with no immediate concerns reported. During the Jo & Joe check, staff provided a further update on the guest previously identified as a potential concern: he remained inside his dormitory room, and management intended to offer him the choice of leaving the premises or transferring to a private room. Security remained on standby in case assistance was required.
Departed the area and continued patrols towards Gore Street.
Welfare checks at Tribe, El Mexicano Zapata, King Made Noodles, Chargrill and Auckland Harbour Suites; all locations clear. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed Gore Street and continued patrols towards Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart; welfare checks at McDonald's Britomart, Customs Mart, 77 Convenience Store and St Pierre's Sushi, all clear. Remained on standby in the area.
Departed Britomart and continued patrols along Queen Street.

Conducted welfare checks along Queen Street from Q Convenience through to Vulcan Lane, including Swanson Street. No sign of the person of interest during the initial patrol; upon reaching Vulcan Lane, observed the POI sleeping on a public bench. Continued patrols along Queen Street. (Photo on file.)
Observed the POI walking down Queen Street; security approached the individual, who became aggressive during the interaction. Security continued following and monitoring the individual.
The male POI was arrested at the intersection of Queen Street and Shortland Street in connection with an outstanding warrant. Security remained in the area to maintain a visible presence.
Received a response call from Macpac Queen Street requesting assistance with a female who had entered the store and was known to staff for previous theft incidents; responded to the location.

Arrived at Macpac Queen Street and assisted staff with removing the female POI from the premises; a trespass notice was issued to the individual. The situation was resolved without further reported incident. Security remained on standby.
Departed the area and continued patrols along Queen Street towards HQ, conducting welfare checks on surrounding businesses.

Completed welfare checks on businesses from Chemist Warehouse and JB Hi-Fi through to the stores around Durham Street; all clear with no issues reported. Maintained a brief security presence in the area.
Continued welfare checks on surrounding businesses.

Arrived at the intersection of Queen Street and Victoria Street; maintained a visible security presence and assisted visitors from outside Auckland who were enquiring about the role and responsibilities of security personnel.
Departed the area and returned towards HQ to use the facilities and commence a break.
Received a response call from Jo & Joe requesting security assistance and a visible presence regarding the previously reported guest situation; personnel prepared to respond.

Received a follow-up call from Jo & Joe advising that security attendance was no longer required. Staff confirmed one warning would be issued to the guest and the General Manager would be notified, with any further decisions to be made by the General Manager. Security stood down from the response.
Remained on standby at HQ awaiting the incoming shift for handover.
Morning shift concluded; handover to the afternoon shift completed successfully.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key. Standing by until guards arrive.
Guard arrived on-site; conducting a short debrief.
Charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage.

Received two response calls — from Mecca and from McDonald's Queen Street. The Mecca incident was prioritised due to reports of a female shouting and disturbing customers outside the premises; security immediately responded to Mecca.

Arrived at Mecca and spoke with staff regarding the reported disturbance; located the female outside the premises and approached her calmly, requesting that she move along. She complied and departed without further incident. Security then proceeded to the second response call at McDonald's Queen Street regarding a vagrant sheltering outside the premises.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street and located the individual outside the premises; approached the person respectfully and requested that they move along. Remained on standby while the individual gathered their belongings.
The individual successfully moved away from McDonald's Queen Street with their belongings; no further issues reported. Resumed welfare checks on surrounding businesses.
Continued welfare checks on businesses along Queen Street.
Arrived at Durham Street and commenced a full security sweep.
Welfare check at the corner of Durham Street; all clear, no issues reported.
Completed a full sweep of Durham Street, including the corner businesses and both Wilson Carparks; all locations clear with no concerns reported.

Received a response call from Elliott Stables regarding a male vagrant who had entered the premises, disturbed customers and approached multiple food businesses requesting free food; security immediately responded.

Arrived at Elliott Stables and spoke with staff; the individual had already left before security arrived. Staff expressed concerns for their safety following the incident. Security decided to maintain a visible presence at Elliott Stables until the assigned security guard arrived on-site (16:36–17:04).
Received a call from management requesting assistance in locating a lanyard for a fellow security guard working at AKA Rooftop Bar; departed towards HQ to check for the item.
Checked HQ for the requested lanyard but was unable to locate one; returned towards Elliott Stables to continue maintaining security presence following the earlier disturbance.
Welfare checks along Darby Street, including Mali Thai, Celine's Eatery, Recycle Boutique and Pizza Club; all businesses clear. Continued patrols towards Elliott Street.
Welfare checks at Elliott Carpark, Domino's, The Fresh Market, Mr Snacks, Food Junction Indian, and Chicken and Chips and Fish; no concerns reported.
Completed welfare checks at Elliott Atrium and the food court; both clear with no issues reported. Continued towards Elliott Stables.
Arrived at Elliott Stables and resumed maintaining a visible security presence while monitoring for further disturbances (17:20–17:44).
Stood down from Elliott Stables; departed towards HQ to prepare for scheduled floor checks.
Arrived at HQ and remained on standby awaiting floor checks.
Completed a full security sweep of Victoria Street; welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store and SkyMart.
Completed a full patrol sweep of Federal Street; arrived at Federal Square and commenced a security sweep of the surrounding area (18:19–18:46).
Completed a full security sweep of Federal Square; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols towards Swanson Street.
Completed a full sweep of Swanson Street West; continued patrols towards Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart; all clear, no issues reported.
Completed a full security sweep of Albert Street; all clear with no concerns observed. Continued patrols towards Lower Albert Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Lower Albert Street; continued patrols along Quay Street towards Commercial Bay.

Completed patrol of Quay Street; all clear, no issues reported. Arrived at Britomart and commenced a security sweep of the area, maintaining a visible presence throughout Commercial Bay (19:04–19:50).
Completed a full security sweep of Commercial Bay; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols towards Customs Street West.
Completed a full patrol sweep of Customs Street West; all clear with no concerns observed.
Welfare checks along Gore Street, including Liquor K, Smiley Mart and Auckland Harbour Suites; all locations clear with no issues reported.
Welfare checks at Tribe Hotel and Sal's Pizza; continued patrols through the surrounding area.
Completed a full security sweep of Fort Street, including welfare checks on surrounding businesses; all clear. Continued patrols towards Fort Lane.
Completed a full patrol sweep of Fort Lane; welfare check, all clear:
Completed a security sweep of Shortland Street; welfare checks at Taco Bell and Shortland Mart. Continued patrols towards High Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Vulcan Lane; all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and commenced a full security sweep of the area.
Welfare checks along O'Connell Street and Chancery Street, including Circle K Mart and Twelve Bakery; all businesses clear. Continued patrols through Chancery Square.
Completed a full security sweep of Freyberg Place and Chancery Square; both locations clear with no issues reported.
Completed a full patrol sweep of High Street; all clear with no issues observed. Continued patrols towards Lorne Street.
Welfare check around the Lorne Street staircase mural; all clear, no issues reported.
Completed a full security sweep of Lorne Street; all clear with no concerns observed. Continued patrols towards Wellesley Street.
Completed patrol of Wellesley Street; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols towards Queen Street.
Welfare checks at McDonald's Queen Street, Timezone Centre, 77 Convenience Store, Avachi, BBQ Chicken and MidCity; all businesses clear. Continued patrols towards Darby Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Darby Street; welfare checks at Celine's Eatery and Mali Thai Food, both clear. Continued patrols towards Elliott Street.
Welfare check and full sweep of Elliott Wilson Carpark; all clear, no issues observed.
Welfare checks at The Fresh Market and Domino's; both businesses clear with no concerns reported.
Arrived at Elliott Stables and maintained a visible security presence while monitoring the area for potential disturbances (21:08–21:27).
Conducted a final welfare check at Elliott Stables; all clear with no concerns reported. Departed towards HQ for a 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ and commenced a 30-minute break.
Meal break completed; the second night-shift security guard had arrived on-site. Remained at HQ awaiting the incoming shift for handover.
Afternoon shift concluded; handover to the night shift completed successfully.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received (deployed 22:33): 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Radios.
Provided access for the third security guard; remained at HQ charging the Ops Phone due to low battery (22:35–23:51).
Prepared equipment and commenced patrol duties.
Arrived at Bar 101 and maintained a visible security presence due to large crowds gathered around the venue (23:56–00:29).
Observed a male individual consuming alcohol in a public area; security intervened and removed the alcohol from the individual.
Welfare check at Bar 101; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols towards Victoria Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Victoria Street; welfare check at 77 Convenience Store before continuing towards Federal Street.
Completed a full patrol sweep of Federal Street; all clear with no concerns observed. Arrived at Federal Square and commenced a security sweep of the area.
Completed a full security sweep of Federal Square; welfare checks at St Patrick's Cathedral and Liston House, both clear with no issues reported.
Welfare checks at Ace Karaoke Bar and Livehouse; all clear with no concerns reported. Continued patrols towards Albert Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Albert Street, including a welfare check at Albert Mart; continued patrols towards Lower Albert Street.
Completed a full patrol sweep of Lower Albert Street; all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Reign & Pour and maintained a visible security presence due to a large event taking place at the venue.
Welfare checks at Reign & Pour and Kemuri; checked in with the assigned security guards, who reported no concerns. Continued patrols towards Quay Street.
Welfare check at Take 10 and checked in with the assigned security guard; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols.
Completed a full security sweep of Quay Street; continued patrols towards the Viaduct entertainment precinct to conduct welfare checks.
Observed a female individual consuming alcohol in a public area; security intervened and removed the alcohol from the individual. No further issues reported.
Completed a full patrol sweep of the Viaduct area; welfare checks at Lula's, Rosie's and Danny Doolan's, all venues clear with no concerns reported. Continued patrols back towards Britomart.
While patrolling towards Britomart, observed two male individuals physically fighting outside Reign & Pour. Security immediately intervened and separated both individuals to prevent further violence.

Both individuals repeatedly attempted to resume the physical altercation despite security intervention. Due to the ongoing risk of further violence, security maintained a visible presence and continued monitoring both parties until they departed the area.
Conducted a follow-up welfare check at Reign & Pour; the situation had settled and no further incidents were observed. Security resumed routine patrols.
Arrived at Britomart and maintained a visible security presence due to high pedestrian activity and large crowds in the surrounding area (02:00–02:26).
Completed a full security sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Continued patrols towards Customs Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Customs Street West; all clear with no concerns observed. Continued patrols towards Fort Street.

Completed a full patrol sweep of Fort Street; welfare checks at Tribe Hotel, Gore Street, Commerce Street and Wilson Carpark on Fort Street, all locations clear. Continued patrols towards Queen Street.
Welfare checks along Shortland Street, including Shortland Mart; all clear with no concerns reported. Continued patrols along Queen Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Queen Street; all clear, no issues observed.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street and checked in with the assigned security guard; all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Bar 101 and maintained a visible security presence while standing by for any incidents or disturbances (03:12–03:56).
Conducted a final welfare check at Bar 101; all clear, no issues reported. Departed towards HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ and commenced charging the Ops Phone due to low battery (03:58–05:15).
Received a response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a male individual inside the premises who was refusing to leave; security immediately responded to the location.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart and observed multiple Police officers already attending the location. Security remained on standby to provide any assistance required by Police or restaurant staff.
Continued maintaining security presence at Britomart while remaining available to assist Police if required.
Completed a full security sweep of Britomart and conducted a follow-up welfare check at McDonald's Britomart; all clear with no further issues reported. Departed towards HQ for shift handover.
Arrived at HQ and remained on standby awaiting the incoming morning security team.
Night shift concluded; handover to the morning shift completed successfully.

flags: SENSITIVE: 01:38 physical fight between two males outside Reign & Pour — security physically intervened and separated the parties; both repeatedly attempted to re-engage before departing.

SENSITIVE: two Police arrests during the day — 07:40 prisoner-transport arrest outside 205 Queen Street (photographed), and 12:35 warrant arrest at Queen/Shortland after security tracked and monitored the POI.
CAPACITY: 15:51 two simultaneous response calls (Mecca and McDonald's Queen Street) — Mecca prioritised, McDonald's queued and attended at 16:03.
QA: afternoon guard arrived 14:47 (standby until arrival); first patrol activity logged 15:51. Morning log has no timestamped entries between 06:30 deployment and 07:40.

capacity.call: McDonald's Queen Street — simultaneous with Mecca call
capacity.note: Two simultaneous calls; Mecca attended first.
